scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('coverage',{recursive:true})" && cargo llvm-cov --package admin-rust-core --fail-under-lines 80 --json --summary-only --output-path coverage/llvm-cov.json && node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --exclude admin-rust-app --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p admin-rust-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings

coverage.measured: core (crate admin-rust-core), 80% lines, cargo llvm-cov (research R9)
coverage.excluded: app (crate admin-rust-app): Leptos views and browser glue compiled only to WebAssembly, which cargo llvm-cov cannot measure natively. Constitution VI's replacement control: every Rust screen is driven by a browser test (the @admin journeys in the admin-rust Playwright project, plus 037 S1-S5, S10, and SL).
